latestVersion.changelog:
- Requires youdaonote CLI version 1.3.2 or higher (was 1.2.3).
- All Wiki-related commands must now add the global parameter `-s wiki` to enable feature usage statistics.
- Documentation updated: examples and procedures in SKILL.md now consistently use `-s wiki`.
- No functional logic changes beyond statistics tracking and CLI version enforcement.
